name: cannon_e
prompt: A single heavy black iron cannon on the deck of an old wooden sailing ship fires once with a deep thunderous boom and a burst of white smoke, then the smoke drifts away in silence. Audio: one loud deep cannon shot with a booming low rumble echoing over the sea, nothing else.

name: cannon_f

name: cannon_g

name: cannon_h

name: hitwood_c
prompt: Quiet ship deck, then suddenly a heavy iron cannonball crashes through the wooden bulwark, splinters exploding everywhere. Audio: silence, then one violent crash of smashing timber, cracking planks and splinters clattering on the deck.

name: splash_c
